title: College Football
description:
North Texas at Indiana
The Mean Green play the Hoosiers at the Memorial Stadium in Bloomington for a Saturday Week 1 opener. Indiana looks to maintain top form after finishing No.1 in the final 2025 poll, while visiting North Texas aims to improve off a No.24 rank finish.

title: College Football
description:
Boston College at Cincinnati
The Bearcats host the Eagles at Nippert Stadium as both programs kick off Week 1. Cincinnati looks to rebound after closing 2025 with a 35-13 Liberty Bowl loss against the Midshipmen, while Boston looks to build on its 34-12 ACC win over Syracuse.

title: MLB Baseball
description:

The San Diego Padres host the New York Yankees at Petco Park as their three-game interleague series continues. Left-hander Robbie Ray takes the mound for San Diego, while New York lefty Carlos Rodon starts in this regular-season game.
